text: W.D. Concord West d.o.o. is 50% owned by Željko Drčelić, the president of basketball club Crvena zvezda, and 50% by the company RAIMS Development.
short: W.D. Concord West is held 50/50 by club president Željko Drčelić and RAIMS Development.

source.name: Nova ekonomija: Firma čiji je suvlasnik Željko Drčelić gradiće Prihvatilište za beskućnike na Voždovcu
source.quote: Kompanija W.D. Concord West d.o.o je, kao što je već pomenuto, 50 odsto u vlasništvu Željka Drčelića, dok drugih 50 odsto ima firma „RAIMS Development“
